description: This source file contains helper functions for dealing with large numbers of Git packs, including creating packs and setting up a repository with many packs to prevent garbage collection.

methods.name: create_packs
methods.description: Creates a specified number of dummy packs with a single blob each, using Perl to generate pack content and feeding it into 'git fast-import'.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Configures Git to disable automatic garbage collection and packing, then calls create_packs to generate many packs to the repository.
